name: baselines-rs
description: Fast baseline correction for signals and surfaces, powered by Rust and WebAssembly

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg && node prepare-package.mjs
scripts.test: node smoke.mjs && node smoke-auto.mjs && node smoke-node.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --lib ESNext,DOM --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext type-smoke.ts
